questions.text: Which behavior indicates fear according to Lesson 1?
options: Entering after price surged due to FOMO
Doubling position size after a win
Hesitating to take a valid setup after a small loss
questions.explanation: Fear manifests as hesitating on valid setups after small losses or panic‑closing profitable trades early.

questions.text: True or false: Discipline means sitting on your hands until the market comes to your predefined zone instead of chasing a move.
questions.explanation: Lesson 2 defines discipline as waiting for the market to reach your pre‑set zone rather than chasing moves.

questions.text: What is the first step in reviewing setbacks per Lesson 3?
options: Increase position size to recover losses
Set a deadline for recovering losses
Recognise emotional influence and stop trading if needed
questions.explanation: Step one is to recognise emotional influence and stop trading if you are angry, anxious, rushed or desperate.

questions.text: True or false: Fear shows up as entering trades after price has already surged, driven by FOMO.
questions.explanation: Entering after a surge due to FOMO is a sign of greed, not fear.
